_note: Stub data for 02-CreateAuditTests. Naming: bva = boundary value, ep = equivalence partition, dt = decision table, eg = error guessing. Preview partials are merged over stubPreview()'s defaults (support/InventoryAudit/auditHelpers.js), so each key below states only the numbers its own test reads.

name._note: MAX_NAME is 150 (Joi, audit-management schema). The input deliberately accepts one character over so the error is observable rather than silently truncated.

workers._note: The assignable-worker roster. CreateAudit renders each option as 'name (email)', so epEmailFragment matches Bob's e-mail and NOT Alice's — that is what makes the filter test narrow to exactly one option.

locations._note: The scope tree the picker walks, keyed by parentId ('root' for the top call). Labels render as '<name> (<code>) - <type>'. Bin A1 carries childCount 0, which is what ends the drill-down and raises the leaf-bin note.

preview._note: Four preview states. An ABC audit reports binCount ('Bins'); a Location audit reports scopeBinCount ('Bins to walk') because it generates a task for every in-scope bin, empty ones included (CreateAudit.tsx:356). The two numbers differ in dtLocationBinsToWalk on purpose — TC57 asserts that they must.

conflicts._note: The two 409 bodies the create screen must surface verbatim. The scope-overlap one names the audit already holding the scope, which is the part the user needs in order to act.

egDuplicateName.message: An active audit named "cy-dup" already exists.

egScopeOverlap.message: Zone 01 (Zone) overlaps the live audit "Existing overlapping audit" (InProgress, scope Zone 01 (Zone)), which counts the same units. A bin can only be counted by one audit at a time - close or cancel that audit first, pick a scope that does not overlap it, or count a different ABC class there (this one is class A).
